title: Don’t waste your time.
body: First off, the 3 day trial is non existent. I selected the yearly plan on the assumption that if it did I what was claimed, I’d use it. From what little I saw, it was no better than others. If you chance units, it doesn’t take effect till you close and re-open the app. I also found that the scale down at the bottom of the map that says go forward an hour or back an hour does not refresh the map. I decided to go ahead and delete the app. Cancel the subscription and I go in and find my surprise. The app charged my account $20 and I now have the use of this useless app for the next year. l’d give it zero stars if I could.

title: No quality control
body: I set English units, mpg, feet, Fahrenheit, inches of mercury yet visibility was in kilometers and rainfall in millimeters. Most weather apps have hourly estimates for the next 7 days for temp, wind, and rainfall. This app only fas the current day with high temps and a % of rainfall by day. The do have a map with temps, rain, wind using colors to indicate the value. But it is static and only 2-3 days out not 7-10 days. Ffor the price it’s a total waste of money. If you insist on spending money get the official app from NOAA. Or many of the excellent free apps
